---
name: Feature request / 功能建议
about: Suggest an improvement or device adaptation / 提出改进或设备适配需求
title: "[Feature] "
---

## Need / 使用需求

What are you trying to accomplish? / 你希望完成什么操作？

## Proposed behavior / 希望的效果

Describe the interface or workflow. / 描述希望的界面或使用流程。

## Relevant device/environment / 相关设备与环境

For adaptation requests, include model, integration name/version, and entity domain/capabilities. Remove tokens, serial numbers and personal identifiers; do not attach configuration files. / 适配需求请提供型号、集成名称与版本、实体类型及能力，隐藏 Token、序列号和个人标识，不附个人配置。

## Alternatives / 当前替代方式

How do you handle this today? / 目前如何完成这项操作？
